Replace.Text: 黄金是一种柔软、有光泽、有延展性的金属，在历史上一直受到人们的珍视。它是一种稀有金属，它的稀有性大大增加了它的价值。尽管黄金有一些工业和医药用途，但它主要用作铸币或装饰用途，装饰珠宝、杯子、器皿和超级富豪和有权有势的人的用具。

Gold is a soft, shiny and malleable metal, and it has been prized by men and women throughout history. It is a rare metal, and its rarity greatly adds to its value. Although it has some industrial and medicinal purposes, gold is used primarily as coinage or for decorative purposes, adorning jewelry, cups, utensils and the commodes of the super-rich and powerful.

To achieve a [COLOR:DiplomaticLabelCS]DIPLOMATIC[ENDCOLOR] victory, be the first to accumulate the target number of Diplomatic Points. Whenever you vote for the target and option combination that passes for a World Congress Resolution, you will earn one Diplomatic Point. You can earn additional points through the Diplomatic Victory Proposal in the World Congress, by generating the highest score in Aid Requests, or the Statue of Liberty, Mahabodhi Temple, or Potala Palace Wonders etc.
